digest.component_or_area: contribution flow and code review process
propositions: Authors must mark Gerrit changes as WIP when they contain known unresolved issues, review findings being folded in, or deliberate holds.
The WIP hold must be documented with both the push-time form (%wip) and the REST endpoint toggle (/wip), along with the unmark paths (%ready and /ready).
Ticket comments and session logs are invisible to submitters and do not prevent submission; WIP is the only hold mechanism that structurally enforces a change cannot be merged.
The WIP rule must be reachable through multiple author-facing surfaces: CONTRIBUTING.md §2d (authoritative), the packaged code-review guide (rebar explain review), and AGENTS.md.
Tests must verify the rule is present across all three surfaces through packaged registry mappings, not file paths, to ensure future edits cannot silently drop it from any surface.
